summary: Marriott International filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.25 billion debt offering, comprising $250 million of 4.875% Series NN Notes due 2029 (a reopening of an existing series) and $1.0 billion of 5.650% Series YY Notes due 2036. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, issued in book-entry form via DTC, with joint book-running managers including J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, and Citigroup. This is an ordinary debt financing transaction, not a special situation; proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No deal terms apply as it is a routine capital markets issuance.
